protocol.title: Ultra-fast, label-free isolation of circulating tumor cells from blood using spiral microfluidics
protocol.platform: Spiral inertial microfluidic biochip (PDMS/glass, continuous-flow, label-free)
protocol.objective: Size-based, label-free isolation of viable circulating tumor cells (CTCs) from lysed whole blood using combined inertial lift force and Dean drag force in a two-loop spiral microchannel; downstream immunofluorescence staining and CTC enumeration

device.material: PDMS bonded to glass slide (76 mm x 52 mm)

separation_physics.principle: Combined inertial lift force (FL) and Dean drag force (FD) in curvilinear microchannel
separation_physics.inertial_lift_force: FL = CL * rho * G^2 * ac^4 / DH^2; CL ~0.5; G = Umax/DH; Umax ~2*UF
separation_physics.ctc_focusing: Inner wall (larger cells, >15 um; FL dominates over FD at outlet)
separation_physics.blood_cell_migration: Outer wall (smaller cells, 3-15 um; follow Dean vortex streamlines)

performance.sample_input: 7.5 mL whole blood lysed and resuspended to 3.75 mL PBS (2x concentrated)
performance.negative_control_threshold: >7 CK+ cells per sample = positive patient

reagents.priming_buffer: 70% v/v ethanol in sterile deionized water
reagents.rbc_lysis_buffer: 3x ammonium chloride RBC lysis buffer (G-Bioscience, cat. no. 786650); 1:3 v/v with blood
reagents.permeabilization_agent: 0.1% v/v Triton X-100 (Thermo Scientific, cat. no. 85111)
reagents.blocking_agent: 0.5% w/v BSA (Miltenyi Biotec, cat. no. 130-091-376) in PBS

qc_beads.purpose: Surrogate for RBCs (6 um), WBCs (10 um), CTCs (15 um) in device QC check

reagents.pdms: Sylgard 184 silicone elastomer kit (Dow Corning), base:curing agent 10:1 w/w

cell_culture_media.complete_DMEM: DMEM (Life Technologies, cat. no. 11965-092) + 10% FBS + 1% pen/strep
cell_culture_media.trypsin: 0.25% w/v with EDTA (Lonza, cat. no. CC-5012)

steps.name: Design and mold preparation
steps.notes: AutoCAD design submitted to vendor for mask printing. Alternatively, micromilling on aluminum or stainless steel master. Not encoded in BioScript (physical fabrication step).

steps.name: Master fabrication (photolithography)

details.photoresist: AZ9260, spin-coated at 500 rpm (10 s) then 3000 rpm (30 s)

steps.critical: Channel depth must be 160-170 um; outside tolerance causes particle focusing failure
steps.notes: Not encoded in BioScript (physical fabrication step).

steps.name: Soft lithography and chip production

details.hole_punching: 1.5 mm puncher (single layer); 4 mm bottom + 1.5 mm top (multiplexed)
details.plasma_cleaning: RF 300 W, 13.56 MHz, 100 mTorr, 2 min 30 s, 2 sccm O2, 22 C
details.bonding: PDMS to glass; press 30 s with tweezers; avoid pressure over channels

steps.notes: Multiplexed device: 3 PDMS molds stacked and plasma-bonded with manual alignment. Not encoded in BioScript.

steps.name: Chip priming - ethanol sterilization
steps.notes: 70% v/v ethanol in sterile deionized water; removes air bubbles and sterilizes channel interior. Required for cell culture downstream applications.

steps.name: Chip priming - sheath buffer surface coating
steps.notes: Coats PDMS microchannel walls with BSA to minimize non-specific cell adhesion during spiral processing.

steps.name: Bubble removal inspection
steps.notes: Inverted microscope inspection in bright-field mode. Increasing sheath flow rate dislodges residual air pockets. If bubbles cannot be removed, replace chip.

steps.name: QC bead check
steps.imaging: Phase-contrast microscope + high-speed camera (VisionResearch Phantom v9)
steps.pass_criterion: 6 um beads complete Dean cycle (inner to outer wall); 15 um beads focus at inner wall outlet

steps.name: RBC lysis
steps.endpoint: Sample color changes to dark red (complete lysis)
steps.notes: Warm blood to room temperature (24-26 C) before lysis. If spiking with cancer cell lines, add cells before lysis step. Total cell loss from lysis + centrifugation <8%.

steps.name: Cell pelleting and resuspension
steps.storage: On ice; process within 2-4 h at 4 C
steps.notes: 7.5 mL whole blood resuspended into 3.75 mL PBS (0.5x original volume).

steps.name: Spiral biochip processing
steps.notes: Allow flow to stabilize ~1 min before collecting CTC fraction. Do not disturb setup during processing. Sheath buffer run 2 min before starting sample pump.

steps.name: Cell concentration post-spiral
steps.notes: Pellet CTCs from inner outlet collection. Resuspend in ~250 uL PBS before fixation.

steps.name: PFA fixation
steps.storage: Fixed cells stable overnight in PBS at 4 C
steps.caution: PFA is a suspected carcinogen; wear gloves, lab coat, goggles

steps.name: Triton X-100 permeabilization
steps.notes: Solubilizes plasma membrane to allow intracellular antibody access for pan-cytokeratin staining.

steps.name: Antibody and Hoechst staining
steps.ctc_phenotype: pan-CK+, CD45-, Hoechst+, round nuclei, high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratio
steps.storage: Stained cells stable overnight in PBS under dark at 4 C

steps.name: CTC fluorescence detection and enumeration

imaging_platform.scan_format: 1 mm x 1 mm grid per well

steps.ctc_criteria: Hoechst+, pan-CK+, CD45-, round nuclei, high N/C ratio
steps.negative_control: 10 healthy volunteer samples; threshold >7 CK+ cells = positive

culture.notes: CTCs viable post-isolation; suitable for ex vivo culture and drug testing

downstream_applications.single_cell_analysis: Compatible; CTCs in suspension, not immobilized

basic_blocks.label: main
basic_blocks.content: Chip priming (ethanol, sheath buffer, bubble removal), QC bead check, RBC lysis, cell pelleting, spiral processing, cell concentration, PFA fixation, washes, permeabilization, antibody staining, final resuspension

troubleshooting.problem: Residual PDMS trapped in spiral channel
troubleshooting.solution: Increase sheath buffer flow rate or replace chip
Increase sheath buffer flow rate or replace chip

troubleshooting.cause: Channel height out of tolerance (must be 165-170 um); improper DRIE
Bubble in channel or incorrect flow rate
troubleshooting.solution: Ensure bubble-free chip; verify flow rate and syringe diameter parameters

troubleshooting.cause: Large clusters trapped at bifurcation point
troubleshooting.solution: Increase sheath flow rate or replace chip

troubleshooting.cause: Insufficient blocking, expired or high antibody concentration
troubleshooting.solution: Increase BSA to >=2%; reduce antibody to 1:150; use fresh antibodies
